# Copilot instructions

Read [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md) first. It covers the skills, the scripts, the write rules, and how to work on the code.

The entry point for Sophos Fusion work is [skills/playbooks/SKILL.md](../skills/playbooks/SKILL.md).

Every write to a tenant needs the user's approval for that write, then `--yes` (and `--production` on a production profile).
